title: Unexplored Martian lava tubes

tellings.quote: well on Mars there's a lot of lava tubes that we've never been inside those lava tubes. So what is there inside?

plain: Mars has many lava tubes, long underground tunnels left behind by flowing lava, and no one has ever been inside them, so no one knows what they hold. A guest named Chris Gilbert raises this on the show, without naming a source, as an open question about what could be hidden there.
